articles.title: Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round: Report
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange was reportedly looking to use the additional funding to regain market share following Binance’s 2023 settlement with US authorities.

articles.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
articles.snippet: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.

articles.title: Thailand crypto ETFs may see slow start despite new rules: CoinShares
articles.snippet: Thailand’s new Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules take effect Friday, but CoinShares expects modest initial inflows as existing investment options compete for demand.

articles.title: VanEck seeks to withdraw application for Lido staked Ether ETF
articles.snippet: VanEck initially filed an S-1 registration statement for the exchange-traded fund in October last year.
